counters.label: metro stations closed on Monday (6 am to 4 pm)

items.text: Rahul Gandhi's press conference at Indira Bhawan is about to begin ahead of the Supreme Court march. He wrote on X with #ChaloDilli: march for democracy, march for justice. The march is to set out at 1:30 pm from Connaught Place-Barakhamba Road.
Live: the India bloc's Supreme Court march, direct pictures from Delhi

Chief Justice Surya Kant said he had already sent, on Sunday night, a reply to the opposition leaders' request for a meeting, stating the reasons. According to him the Supreme Court's doors are open to all; according to sources, because the matter is pending in court, he advised filing a petition.
After not getting permission for 10 October, the CJP has sought a new date for a protest in Delhi. Mamata Banerjee and Akhilesh Yadav confirmed they will join today's India bloc march.
The Delhi High Court Bar Association asked members to wear black armbands today. The Association alleges that Delhi Police used excessive force on lawyers in the 10 October protests.
Former Haryana Chief Minister Bhupinder Singh Hooda reached Delhi for the march with Haryana Congress MLAs and MPs. He says the protest will continue until Gyanesh Kumar resigns.

The Citizens for Fraternity Forum wrote to Delhi Police asking it to make public the findings of the inquiry into the alleged disorder during the protest near Gurdwara Bangla Sahib; the letter was also sent to the Prime Minister, Home Minister and Minorities Commission.
AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi: the Supreme Court has also said that protest is every citizen's right. He clarified that he is not part of the India bloc.

Before the march, Congress workers gathered at Himachal Bhawan and Karnataka Bhawan; tents and fans were set up at the Congress headquarters at 24 Akbar Road. Barricades and heavy police, RAF and CRPF deployment around Jantar Mantar, Mandi House, Connaught Place and the AICC office; prohibitory orders outside Parliament Street police station.

The other side: on a complaint from the Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee, police registered an FIR against AAP leaders. Committee president Harmeet Singh Kalka alleges that AAP workers waved banners, raised slogans and spread misleading videos at the Bangla Sahib complex. Police are examining the videos; AAP's reply has not yet come.
Live: security tightened in Delhi ahead of the CJP and India bloc protest

BJP's side: spokesperson C.R. Kesavan accused Rahul Gandhi of politicising constitutional institutions including the judiciary; MP K. Laxman said Congress is misleading people on SIR; Dilip Ghosh called the protests an attempt at intimidation.

According to a news agency report, barricades were reduced in several places before the protests. At Sunday's special hearing the Supreme Court had said barricading everywhere is not right, no one should be detained outside the law, and the metro, rail and internet should run normally.

items.h: Movement shut at six metro stations from 6 am to 4 pm: Patel Chowk, Janpath, Rajiv Chowk, Mandi House, Central Secretariat, Barakhamba Road
Chief Justice Surya Kant declines to meet India bloc leaders, says: file a petition

items.text: According to reports, the Kerala Assembly is to pass a resolution today against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
